title: Sidebar 'N synced' counts docs the SyncDot calls 'Never checked'
body:
## Summary
DocSidebar's summary line counts a synced document with no lastCodeHash as synced, while the SyncDot beside it shows the same document as 'Never checked'.

## Description
SyncDot (src/components/modules/content/level-design/LevelDesignView/SyncDot.tsx:27) and SyncStatusPanel resolveSyncPresentation (src/components/modules/content/level-design/SyncStatusPanel.tsx:58) degrade `synced` + null hash to Never checked. The sidebar count (src/components/modules/content/level-design/LevelDesignView/DocSidebar.tsx:166) reads summary.syncedCount from deriveSummary (src/hooks/useDesignDocument.ts:57-88) / getSummary (src/lib/level-design-db.ts:168), which count every `synced` row. Fixed = both summaries count only synced docs that carry a lastCodeHash (or a separate neverChecked bucket), keeping the 7cd6a083 parity test in step.

## Flow
- generate code for a doc (codegen stamps synced, no hash)
- sidebar shows '1 synced'; the doc's dot shows Never checked

## Expected impact
Designers stop reading an unverified 'synced' count. Could break: the summary parity test pins the current buckets and must move with it.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - one verdict for 'is this doc synced' across the sidebar
Before: walked: doc {syncStatus:'synced', lastCodeHash:null} -> sidebar '1 synced', SyncDot 'Never checked' (2 surfaces disagree)
After: predicted 0 disagreements
Method: simulation - fix site is src/hooks + src/lib (feature-design-state-hooks / game-world-content-api), outside this round
Result: better
Gate: none
evidence: DocSidebar.tsx:166-167 summary.syncedCount; SyncDot.tsx:27 status==='synced' && !lastCodeHash -> NEVER_CHECKED; useDesignDocument.ts deriveSummary counts synced unconditionally
instrument: render DocSidebar + SyncDot on a synced/null-hash doc and assert the count and the dot agree; seed red on today's tree

title: Codegen completion stamps whichever document is open when the run ends
body:
## Summary
codegenCli.onComplete commits {syncStatus:'synced'} into the buffer of the document active at completion time, not the one the run generated code for.

## Description
src/components/modules/content/level-design/LevelDesignView/useLevelDesignView.ts:102-106: the closure reads the latest activeDoc and calls commit(), which writes the CURRENTLY open doc. Switching documents during a multi-minute codegen run marks the second doc synced (and its lastGeneratedAt) though no code was generated for it. Distinct from the recorded docs-sync deviation at :105 (the stamp is unverified); this is the wrong TARGET. Fixed = capture the doc id at dispatch and write the stamp to that id (updateDoc) or drop it when the doc changed.

## Flow
- Generate All Code on doc A
- switch to doc B before the run ends
- run completes -> doc B badge flips synced; doc A unchanged

## Expected impact
A wrong doc no longer claims synced. Could break: the sync-loop tests that pin codegen completion.

## Evaluation
Claim: resilience - codegen stamp lands on the generated doc
Before: walked: dispatch on doc 7, switch to doc 8, complete -> PUT {id:8, syncStatus:'synced'}
After: predicted PUT targets id 7 or none
Method: simulation - needs a useModuleCLI completion harness (sync-loop.test.tsx pattern) not built this round
Result: better
Gate: none
evidence: useLevelDesignView.ts:102-106 onComplete: if (success && activeDoc) commit({ syncStatus: 'synced', lastGeneratedAt })
instrument: sync-loop.test.tsx-style harness: dispatch codegen on doc 7, switch to 8, fire completion; assert the PUT id

title: Level design tab strip exposes no tab semantics or selected state
body:
## Summary
The 11 document tabs are plain buttons; which one is open is conveyed only by an underline.

## Description
src/components/modules/content/level-design/LevelDesignView/TabBar.tsx:49-94: ScrollableTabBar has no role=tablist, TabButton no role=tab / aria-selected / aria-controls, no arrow-key roving; ActiveDocView.tsx renders 11 of them. Fixed = the tablist pattern (or the shared ui/TabBar primitive if it carries it) with aria-selected and arrow keys.

## Flow
- open a doc with a screen reader
- tab across 11 buttons; none announces selected

## Expected impact
Screen-reader and keyboard users can tell which view is open. Could break: tests that query these by role 'button'.

## Evaluation
Claim: user - selected tab announced
Before: 0 of 11 tabs expose selected state (getAllByRole('tab') = 0)
After: 11 tabs, exactly 1 aria-selected=true
Method: simulation - M with arrow-key behaviour and test migration; not taken this round
Result: better
Gate: none
evidence: TabBar.tsx:57-93 <button onClick className=...> with no role/aria-selected
instrument: render ActiveDocView, assert getAllByRole('tab').length===11 and one aria-selected; arrow keys move focus

title: A stored room missing spawnEntries still crashes the room node
body:
## Summary
RoomNodeGraphic reduces room.spawnEntries unguarded; a room blob without that array (CLI-written, older schema) throws.

## Description
src/components/modules/content/level-design/LevelFlowEditor/RoomNodeGraphic.tsx:72 and :269 call room.spawnEntries.reduce; :265 reads .length. The unknown-type crash beside it was fixed tonight (85154e8f roomTypeConfig); the server accepts any element shape (src/app/api/level-design/route.ts:89 only checks Array.isArray). Fixed = normalise rooms on read (rowToDoc or a client normaliser: spawnEntries/linkedFiles/tags default []) so every consumer (RoomDetailPanel, pacing linter, prompts) is covered, not just the node.

## Flow
- a CLI run writes rooms:[{id,name,type,x,y}]
- open the doc -> TypeError reading 'reduce'

## Expected impact
One malformed room no longer takes the flow editor down. Could break: nothing user-visible; normalisation is additive.

## Evaluation
Claim: resilience - malformed room renders
Before: walked: room without spawnEntries -> TypeError at RoomNodeGraphic.tsx:72
After: predicted 0 throws after a read-side normaliser
Method: simulation - the right fix site is the read path (src/lib/level-design-db.ts rowToDoc) owned by game-world-content-api
Result: better
Gate: none
evidence: RoomNodeGraphic.tsx:72 const spawnTotal = room.spawnEntries.reduce(...); route.ts:89 ARRAY_FIELDS check is container-only
instrument: the level-flow-editor-sweep 'unknown room type' test with spawnEntries omitted; red today

title: Two copies of the 'synced without a hash is Never checked' rule
body:
## Summary
SyncDot and SyncStatusPanel each define their own NEVER_CHECKED and their own synced+null-hash test.

## Description
src/components/modules/content/level-design/LevelDesignView/SyncDot.tsx:24,27 and src/components/modules/content/level-design/SyncStatusPanel.tsx:45,58 implement one rule twice with separate labels ('Never checked against code' / 'Never checked'). A third surface (the sidebar count) already disagrees. Fixed = SyncDot consumes resolveSyncPresentation (exported already) and differs only in size.

## Flow
- change the rule in one file
- the other keeps the old verdict

## Expected impact
One rule, one place. Could break: SyncDot label copy changes.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - one implementation of the rule
Before: 2 implementations
After: 1 implementation
Method: simulation - S, but its benefit is drift prevention with no failing case today
Result: better
Gate: none
evidence: SyncDot.tsx:24 const NEVER_CHECKED; SyncStatusPanel.tsx:45 export const NEVER_CHECKED; both: status === 'synced' && !lastCodeHash
instrument: parity test over all 5 statuses x hash/null asserting SyncDot label === resolveSyncPresentation label

title: Level Systems 'Procedural Gen' node ticks 'Create blockout geometry'
body:
## Summary
After tonight's id fix (6941578a), the diagram's Procedural Gen node (ld-1) still marks the unrelated checklist item 'Create blockout geometry', and module-registry quickActions reuse ld-1..3 with meanings different from the checklist.

## Description
src/components/modules/content/level-design/LevelDesignSpatialDiagram/constants.ts:11-21 node ld-1; src/lib/module-registry.ts:729-731 quickActions ld-1 Procedural Gen / ld-2 Level Streaming / ld-3 Spawn System vs checklist ld-1 blockout / ld-2 spawn / ld-3 streaming (:741-747). The checklist has no procgen item, so what the diagram tracks is a product call: add a procgen checklist item, point the node at blockout deliberately, or stop the diagram writing checklist progress.

## Flow
- run Procedural Gen from the empty state
- roadmap item 'Create blockout geometry' flips done

## Expected impact
The roadmap stops claiming work that did not happen. Could break: stored checklist progress under ld-1.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - a run ticks only its own item
Before: 1 of 3 nodes ticks a different item; 3 quickAction ids collide with checklist ids of other meaning
After: 0
Method: simulation - which item procgen is, is a direction decision
Result: unmeasurable
Gate: direction
evidence: module-registry.ts:729 { id: 'ld-1', label: 'Procedural Gen' } quickAction vs :741 { id: 'ld-1', label: 'Create blockout geometry' } checklist

title: RoomType has no runtime list; five hand copies of its eight values
body:
## Summary
src/types/level-design.ts declares RoomType only as a type, so every runtime check re-types the eight values by hand.

## Description
src/types/level-design.ts:3 RoomType union. Copies: src/components/modules/content/level-design/RoomDetailPanel/constants.ts:19 ALL_ROOM_TYPES (typed RoomType[], so a NEW type is silently missing from the picker), src/lib/level-design/reconcile.ts:32 (adopt-code validation), plus Record literals at src/hooks/useDesignDocument.ts:43,59 and src/lib/level-design-db.ts:179. Fixed = `export const ROOM_TYPES = [...] as const` with RoomType derived from it, and the two non-Record copies import it.

## Flow
- add 'treasure' to RoomType
- the room picker and adopt-code validation never learn it; only the Record literals fail to compile

## Expected impact
A new room type reaches the picker and the reconcile validator. Could break: nothing; the literal order is preserved.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - one source for RoomType values
Before: 5 hand copies, 2 not completeness-checked by the compiler
After: 1 runtime list, 0 unchecked copies
Method: simulation - consumers sit in RoomDetailPanel and lib/level-design, outside this round's two type files
Result: better
Gate: none
evidence: RoomDetailPanel/constants.ts:19 export const ALL_ROOM_TYPES: RoomType[] = ['combat', ...]; reconcile.ts:32 'combat', 'puzzle', ...
instrument: a type-level test: ROOM_TYPES covers every RoomType (exhaustive Record built from it) and ALL_ROOM_TYPES equals ROOM_TYPES; seed by adding a member to the union

title: LevelDesignSummary distribution fields are computed twice and read by nothing
body:
## Summary
difficultyDistribution and roomTypeDistribution are computed on the server and again on the client, and no UI reads either.

## Description
src/types/level-design.ts:112-113 declare them; src/lib/level-design-db.ts:210-211 and src/hooks/useDesignDocument.ts:57-88 compute them; grep across src (excluding tests) finds 0 readers outside those producers. The 7cd6a083 parity test pins both copies. Fixed = drop the two fields (type, both producers, the parity rows), or give them the consumer they were made for.

## Flow
- grep difficultyDistribution|roomTypeDistribution in src: only the type + 2 producers

## Expected impact
Less to keep in parity. Could break: an out-of-tree reader of the GET /api/level-design summary (pof-mcp) - check first.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - fewer twin fields to keep in step
Before: 2 fields x 2 producers + parity rows, 0 consumers
After: 0
Method: probe - the zero-consumer grep was run; removal touches hooks/db outside this round and the API envelope (pof-mcp may read it)
Result: better
Gate: none
evidence: grep -rn 'difficultyDistribution|roomTypeDistribution' src (non-test): types/level-design.ts:112-113, useDesignDocument.ts:41-88, level-design-db.ts:210-211 only
instrument: grep pof-mcp + e2e for summary readers; then remove and run the summary parity test
